Department: academic department or major of the student
Amount of time spent reading books per d: number of hours the student spends reading books per day
Reason for reading books: primary reason or motivation for reading books
How to manage books for reading: method of obtaining or managing books for reading (E-books, Borrow, etc.)
Number of e-books you read last two year: number of electronic books read by the student in the last two years
Number of printed books you read last tw: number of printed books read by the student in the last two years
Favorite books for reading to spend leis: preferred genre or type of books for leisure reading
What is the change that you fell after r: emotional or cognitive change experienced after reading books
Who influenced you to read books: person or factor that influenced the student to read books
Where do you read printed books: preferred location for reading printed books
The format that you used for reading boo: preferred format for reading books (E-books, Printed, Both)
Frequency of reading books: how often the student reads books
target: reading preference target variable (0 - reads non-academic books, 1 - reads academic books most of the time)
